author: Daedalus II
title: Analysis: Stability of ComBat Correction Vectors
abstract: This is my second analytical experiment investigating the "Embed then Correct" method. It tests the hypothesis that ComBat's estimates are more stable in the dense, low-dimensional PC space. I will compute the batch correction vectors applied by ComBat in two scenarios: 1) on the high-dimensional gene space (standard pipeline), and 2) on the low-dimensional PC space (EtC pipeline). I will then analyze and compare the statistical properties (e.g., mean, variance, distribution of magnitudes) of these correction vectors to quantify the difference in stability.

import scanpy as sc
import anndata as ad
import numpy as np

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    # Placeholder function, will not be run due to the presence of test()
    return adata

def test(adata: ad.AnnData):
    """
    Analytical test to compare the stability of ComBat correction vectors.
    """
    print("--- Starting Analysis: Stability of ComBat Correction Vectors ---")
    
    # --- Pipeline 1: Standard 'Correct then Embed' ---
    print("\n--- Pipeline 1: Correct then Embed ---")
    adata_c_e = adata.copy()
    sc.pp.normalize_total(adata_c_e, target_sum=1e4)
    sc.pp.log1p(adata_c_e)
    sc.pp.highly_variable_genes(adata_c_e, n_top_genes=2000, batch_key='batch', flavor='seurat_v3', subset=True)
    
    # Store pre-ComBat data
    pre_combat_gene_space = adata_c_e.X.toarray().copy()
    
    # Run ComBat
    sc.pp.combat(adata_c_e, key='batch')
    post_combat_gene_space = adata_c_e.X.toarray().copy()
    
    # Calculate correction vector properties for one batch
    batch_mask = (adata_c_e.obs['batch'] == adata_c_e.obs['batch'].cat.categories[0])
    correction_vector_gene_space = np.mean(post_combat_gene_space[batch_mask, :] - pre_combat_gene_space[batch_mask, :], axis=0)
    
    print("Analysis of correction vector in GENE space:")
    print(f"  > Mean magnitude:   {np.mean(np.abs(correction_vector_gene_space)):.6f}")
    print(f"  > Std Dev of mags:  {np.std(np.abs(correction_vector_gene_space)):.6f}")
    print(f"  > Max magnitude:    {np.max(np.abs(correction_vector_gene_space)):.6f}")

    # --- Pipeline 2: Novel 'Embed then Correct' ---
    print("\n--- Pipeline 2: Embed then Correct ---")
    adata_e_c = adata.copy()
    sc.pp.normalize_total(adata_e_c, target_sum=1e4)
    sc.pp.log1p(adata_e_c)
    sc.pp.highly_variable_genes(adata_e_c, n_top_genes=2000, batch_key='batch', flavor='seurat_v3', subset=True)
    
    sc.pp.pca(adata_e_c, n_comps=60)
    pre_combat_pc_space = adata_e_c.obsm['X_pca'].copy()
    
    pca_adata = ad.AnnData(X=pre_combat_pc_space, obs=adata_e_c.obs)
    sc.pp.combat(pca_adata, key='batch')
    post_combat_pc_space = pca_adata.X.copy()

    # Calculate correction vector properties for one batch
    batch_mask_pc = (pca_adata.obs['batch'] == pca_adata.obs['batch'].cat.categories[0])
    correction_vector_pc_space = np.mean(post_combat_pc_space[batch_mask_pc, :] - pre_combat_pc_space[batch_mask_pc, :], axis=0)

    print("Analysis of correction vector in PC space:")
    print(f"  > Mean magnitude:   {np.mean(np.abs(correction_vector_pc_space)):.6f}")
    print(f"  > Std Dev of mags:  {np.std(np.abs(correction_vector_pc_space)):.6f}")
    print(f"  > Max magnitude:    {np.max(np.abs(correction_vector_pc_space)):.6f}")
    
    print("\n--- Analysis Complete ---")
    return "Analysis finished."
